candidates.comment: Thanks for the detailed Windows timeline. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/342774: the disconnected client remains cached, the same SDK error bypasses recovery, and runtime-exit diagnostics are missing. The recovery work in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/345494 should also cover this Windows managed-settings startup-restart case; the CI timing here is useful additional evidence, while the reason the fresh runtime disconnects remains unresolved.

Thanks for the detailed report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346490, which tracks multi-root Copilot Harness Undo failing with this exact error while Keep works. Your reproduction adds a non-Git primary folder and a one-line Markdown edit in a second folder on Windows 11 with VS Code 1.145.2.

Thanks for the request. This is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/304713, which requests the same Search-style tree layout for References. Your use case of navigating many results with independently collapsible nodes belongs there too.

Thanks for the detailed report. Long literal searches producing this warning and misleading "No results" output are already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/220021. This report adds Windows 10 / VS Code 1.145.2 reproduction with extensions disabled, including multiline code snippets and an approximate 4,000-character trigger.

Thanks for the report. This matches the coded-symbol upload HTTP 413 failure tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/343839. This report adds confirmation on Windows with VS Code 1.145.2 and the server response 'length limit exceeded'.

Thanks for the report. This matches the persistent Keep failure tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/344973, including the same error on Windows with VS Code 1.145.2. This report adds that restarting VS Code and temporarily removing/restoring the changes do not recover language.tsx or App.tsx, while other files can still be kept.

Thanks for the report. The difficulty finding enough space to drag the window is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/328251. This adds the useful detail that attempts near the right-hand controls can accidentally activate Open in Agents. You can hide that button with `"chat.titleBar.openInAgentsWindow.enabled": false`, although that does not fully address drag-target discoverability.

Thanks for the detailed request. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346164 already tracks individual selection of workspace instructions, skills, and prompts per chat session, without changing their files or exposing excluded customizations to the agent. Consolidating there should retain this report’s multi-root identity requirements, explicit exclusion of metadata, and the discussion’s distinction between instruction injection, skill discovery, and prompt invocation.

Thanks for the report. This matches the Windows-to-remote Linux chat file-list navigation problem tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346020. This report adds confirmation on 1.145.2 with WSL Ubuntu: direct opening and Open Changes in Diff Editor work, but clicking the file list fails and reloading does not help.

Thanks for the report. Automatic recovery without manually clicking Retry, while keeping the error visible, is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/288094. This report adds the network-interruption case: agents should recover when connectivity returns rather than require each request to be restarted manually.

Thanks for the report. This repeats https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346579, including the Windows 1.145.2 startup steps, logs, and Refresh workaround. That thread also has an independent confirmation, so let's consolidate the investigation there.

Thanks for the report and the crash logs. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/338194, which tracks extension installation failing on Fedora 45 without OpenSSL 3 compatibility libraries. This thread adds x64 and ARM64 verifier crashes, including stable 1.145.2 and Insiders, and confirmation that `sudo dnf install openssl3-libs` restores installation; those details should remain part of the investigation there.

Thanks for the report. This matches the remote changed-file widget problem tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346023. This report adds an Arch Linux-to-Debian reproduction on 1.145.0 and confirms that creating the same path locally makes the widget open the local copy; those details should be retained in the investigation.

Thanks for the report and screenshot. This is the same Keep/Undo toolbar overlap tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/307560. This report adds a Windows 10 example on VS Code 1.141.0 and a screenshot showing obscured code: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/341055#issuecomment-6716305651.
